# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-one  <sub>[v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c3 P7](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c4 P9](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and mother  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and glossy black hair. She has a merry expression and enchanting dimples like little dents in cream. As she grows into womanhood, she becomes somewhat stout and matronly.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v3 c33 P14](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0014), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Diana is a sensible, amiable, and practical girl who loves reading and playing games. She is deeply loyal to her friends, though she lacks the vivid imagination of her closest companion. She is naturally merry and enjoys youthful recreations, yet takes her domestic and maternal responsibilities seriously.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009), [v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006), [v4 c1 P8](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0008)_

## Goals

- To be an eternal friend to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c17 P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004)</sub>
- To build a happy home with her husband and children  <sub>[v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)</sub>

## History

Diana meets Anne Shirley when Anne comes to live at Green Gables, and the two quickly swear eternal friendship. Their early companionship is marked by playhouses, shared stories, and occasional mishaps, including an accidental intoxication on currant wine that temporarily leads Diana's mother to forbid their friendship until Anne saves Minnie May from croup. Diana attends Avonlea school alongside Anne, participating in local entertainments and the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. As they grow up, Diana courts Fred Wright, whom she eventually marries at Orchard Slope. She gives birth to a son, Fred, and later a daughter named Small Anne Cordelia, remaining a close and loving friend to Anne throughout her life.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c29 P9](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0009), [v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c4 P9](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea as the daughter of George Barry  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046)</sub>
- Has a younger sister named Minnie May  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>
